en.title: Present forms for the future
en.summary: English often uses present forms to talk about the future.

paragraphs: English often uses present forms to talk about the future: the present continuous for arrangements and the simple present for timetables.
The present continuous is used for fixed personal arrangements. The simple present is used for official timetables and schedules.

blocks.html:
FormUseExample
present continuousarrangementI am seeing the doctor at ten.
simple presenttimetableThe shop opens at nine.
